original.target_description: Single fMRI experiment: negative linear trend of memory-specific competitor activation across four retrieval repetitions in ventral visual cortex, relative to same-category baseline templates. The broad neural description is consistent, but the supplied page locator does not uniquely specify this test or region.

n.location: Accepted manuscript p.22 (PDF p.23), Participants; p.9 (PDF p.10), target test df=23
n.quote: Twenty-four healthy participants (20 female) aged 20 – 32 years (mean 24.2 years)
n.sample_role: Participants in repeated-measures fMRI competitor-activation analysis; test has denominator df 23.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported for this test. All selective retrieval trials with item-specific templates were analysed; incorrect retrievals included.

es.location: Accepted manuscript p.9 (PDF p.10), Suppression of unique neural patterns representing competing memories
es.quote: memory-specific competitor activation showed a significant (negative) linear trend in ventral visual cortex (F1,23=10.52, p=0.004)

replication.target_description: Second replication attempt, behavioral final forced-choice recognition: paired competitors-versus-baseline comparison. This is a behavioral analogue, not a measurement of neural patterns; no fMRI was acquired. The supplied p.25 is not a page in the acquired published 20-page paper.

n.location: Published p.31 (PDF p.6), section 2.1.2; p.37 (PDF p.12), Fig.4C
n.quote: After excluding the 10 subjects with reversed instructions, we had 22 subjects who met the inclusions criteria for the second replication.
n.sample_role: Analytic participants in second replication behavioral recognition comparison; paired t has df 21.
n.exclusions: 10 subjects with reversed key instructions excluded; additional a priori criteria excluded at/below-chance practice performance or >=25% timeout responses. Timeout responses removed. Paper inconsistently reports 35 recruited and an additional 11 after 25; analytic 22 is explicit.

notes: Both full primary papers acquired from university-hosted PDFs; titles and DOI verified. Original extraction selects the directly named competitor-neural-pattern negative linear trend, not the behavioral forgetting test. Original target_match remains unknown because the terse description/page locator does not identify a unique contrast among several neural tests. Original hippocampal linear trend and omnibus interactions are distinct tests and not merged. Replication study 2 interpreted as the explicitly named second replication attempt, not the third preregistered replication or first preliminary attempt. Replication statistics are retained as a documented behavioral mismatch, not as verification of neural pattern suppression. Published PDF font extraction renders equals as ¼, decimal points as colons, and minus as control character U+0003; value fields transcribe the printed signs/decimal notation. Original and replication es/p are internally paired within their respective tests. No metric conversion performed.
